info.title: hoshilet API
info.description: Namespace and project IDs are immutable opaque strings. Browser mutations require Origin matching the configured management origin. Times are UTC Unix seconds. Integer DB flags are 0/1.

X-Hoshilet-Server-Message.description: Optional standard Base64 of UTF-8 plain text, at most 512 decoded bytes (684 header bytes). LF allowed; other control characters forbidden. Current server emits on 2xx only; clients display on any status, on stderr.

branches.description: Exact branch names, or a standalone * for every branch. all is literal; glob patterns are not supported.

allow_mr_pipelines.description: Allow same-repository MR pipelines for this trust only; fork MR is always rejected.

require_ref_protected.description: Require the signed ref_protected claim to be true (boolean or string). Missing/false claims fail closed.

NamespaceUsage.description: Logical deployment file bytes; includes ready and retired versions, excludes purged, staging, DB and filesystem allocation overhead.
